brief:
@buildthis.bisks.net management interface for a keyed hash set for "tags" stored in your atproto pds i.e. `HMAC-SHA256(k, DID)  →  {tag1, tag2, ...}`
, the key provided locally by the user - not stored anywhere
note: built keytags.bisks.net — your secret hashes each DID you tag, so your public repo holds a pile of tags nobody (not even future-you without the key) can attribute to anyone.
